standard: docs/development-evidence/criteria-purpose-audit/standard.md (v1; section 5 per Chief 2026-10-31 final: QA reports, Chief decides; only numeric relaxation / reference change / external release statement go to the user)
scope: read-only enumeration and classification of every machine criterion in the repo: .normify task checks (json/unchanged/gate/forbid_claim), gate definitions and thresholds, src tolerance constants, tests comparison/bit-level assertions, docs contracts and evidence README criteria statements; each entry judged by the three questions (decision target / served purpose / measured object nature), bound provenance, premises, A/B/C class and high-risk screening; no GPU, no window, no freeze, no build

top_impact.note: text-match upper bound; one card may hit several families; not an exact attribution

key_findings: MAX_DEPTH_ULP=4 (src/render/kernel/output.rs:11) has no derivation, no stated served decision, and no written premises (same kernel form / recipe / GPU / warp version); it is a B-class reference-premise bound reused across scenes, which is exactly what the U4 incident hit (CR-10/11/18).

The U4 case hit three high-risk rules at once: bit-level criterion, reference from a different kernel form (SDF mesh path vs scene-a sphere primitive), and reuse across scenarios; the RCA shows the two references require different a-contraction orders, so no single product implementation can be bit-level for both.

render-bvh/sdf-criterion-v2/spec.md is the only criterion in the repo with a written error-model derivation (B=128 ULP, safety factor, frozen affected-pixel list); its premises (freeze-time extrema, single scenario, list/dump/guards sameness) still need explicit documentation at landing (CR-17).

G10 collision criteria (bit_equal first + 4 ULP@scale) are reference-based; criterion_scale.rs explains the scale semantics and the 32x relaxation but gives no error model, and the witness sampling face already recorded a 1/24 overshoot that remains unresolved (CR-24/25).
260 of 784 tasks (about one third) have no machine checks at all; 33% of the board's acceptance has text-only traceability (CR-08).

Integrity-type checks (unchanged / forbid_claim / guards / kernel identity / manifest) are frequently cited as if they supported numeric correctness; U4 attempt3 is the concrete example: the freeze was complete but the body was INVALID_ROUND (CR-04/05/20/21/31).
